activities.title: Set up the page like a pro
activities.intro: Work on your own invitation letter. Tick each step as you finish it, then check your print preview.

items: Choose your office's paper size (A4 or long 8.5 × 13 in). Keep it portrait.
Add a footer with Page X of Y.
At the end of the letter, press Ctrl + Enter and type "Annex A: Workshop Schedule" on the new page.
Open print preview (Ctrl + P) and check: 2 pages, numbers correct, no lonely signature.

blocks.prompt: How many pages does your print preview show?
What does the footer say on the Annex A page?
In Word, which Margins choice gives 1 inch on every side?
Which size is our long bond paper?
Which keys start the annex on a fresh page?
A screenshot of your print preview

help: No 8.5 × 13: Size › More Paper Sizes › type width 8.5", height 13".
Number on page 1 only: it's in the body, not the footer. Delete it and use Insert › Page Number.
Annex starts mid-page: you pressed Enter, not Ctrl + Enter.

blocks.prompt: You need pages 2, 3 and 5 only, 3 complete sets for 3 signatories. What do you set?
